scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && if [ -f .venv/bin/python3 ]; then .venv/bin/python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000; else python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000; fi
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && if [ -f .venv/bin/python3 ]; then PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests; else PYTHONPATH=. pytest tests; fi
